summary_hint: EMD receipt: {earnest_money_amount} from {buyer} to {escrow_holder} for {property_address}, {payment_method}, received {receipt_date}, {funds_received_status}.

typed_core.name: issuer_name
typed_core.why: identity — the escrow/title/brokerage issuing the receipt

typed_core.name: escrow_holder_or_recipient
typed_core.why: identity — who is holding the funds

typed_core.name: property_address
typed_core.why: identity — the subject property (CORE; flattened from address)

typed_core.name: purchase_contract_date
typed_core.why: disambiguator — ties the receipt to the purchase agreement

typed_core.name: receipt_date
typed_core.why: identity — when the deposit was received

typed_core.name: payer_account_last4
typed_core.why: PII — ties the EMD to the borrower's account (catalog notes this exact use)
typed_core.prompt_hint: Exists to trace the deposit back to the borrower's bank account — capture last-4 verbatim, never infer full digits

typed_core.name: funds_received_status
typed_core.why: processor — received vs cleared vs held

typed_core.name: credited_to_purchase_price
typed_core.why: processor — whether it credits toward price
typed_core.prompt_hint: Distinguish the amount received from any amount credited toward the purchase price

typed_core.name: loan_number
typed_core.why: identity — links to the loan file

encoding_variations: The deposit amount may be labeled 'earnest money', 'good faith deposit', 'initial deposit', or 'escrow deposit' — all the same figure; keep earnest_money_amount
'Received' vs 'cleared/collected' are different states — keep funds_received_status and funds_received_date distinct from receipt_date
Payment trace differs by method: a check number vs a wire/ACH trace — capture whichever the method implies

open_questions.q: Which date is authoritative? receipt_date (when handed over) vs funds_received_date (when cleared) can differ.
open_questions.recommendation: keep both; asset-sourcing cares about cleared funds

open_questions.q: wire_or_ach_trace_number PII class. Restricted but not last-4-masked.
options: keep as a plain restricted typed field
open_questions.recommendation: keep typed, flag — a bare trace number is lower-risk than an account number but should not sit in the unmasked catch-all GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): mask account-like identifiers (policy/account/plan numbers, wire/ACH trace, check references) via _PII_FIELDS; leave addresses and public-record case numbers PLAIN; DOB is unmasked (pii null).

open_questions.q: Overlap with EMD Withdrawal Proof / Bank Deposit Slip. Several asset-trace documents share these fields.
options: confirm no duplication with sibling docs
open_questions.recommendation: confirm no field here duplicates a sibling doc's canonical home

notes: No rules consume this type today, so there is no rule floor; every field earns its place on identity, PII, processor use, or disambiguation.
payer_account_last4 needs _PII_FIELDS registration (pre_masked true); not currently in the 7-field registry.
wire_or_ach_trace_number is a restricted trace identifier kept as a typed field and flagged for possible PII registration; its reason_class is processor (not registered as PII in this draft).
recipient_name_and_title's why cites 'execution', which is not one of the five reason_class values; mapped to processor and flagged as an ambiguity.
Prompt hint (doc-level): this is a real-estate earnest-money / escrow deposit receipt; the depositor is normally the buyer/borrower, the recipient is escrow/title.
